The post was made 56 minutes prior to the screenshot being taken at 3:44 PM. The post features an announcement about the nomination for "Best Special Visual Effects" at the BAFTA Awards for the movie "Guardians of the Galaxy Volume 3." The central focus of the image is a promotional graphic for the movie.
